structure: repos/trade-imports-address-book, read on main (in step with origin/main): a Java 21 / Spring Boot REST service, the INS system of record for an organisation's Standard Address Block records and, since ruling:ian-2026-11-06, its transporters. No views or copy: its behaviour is an HTTP API under /organisation/{orgId}, documented in README.md (395 lines, the API overview, role rules, transporters, soft delete, expiry, indexes and design notes sections), docs/openapi/addresses.yml (1,024 lines, springdoc-generated, 10 operations: addresses and transporters each with list, create, get, replace and soft delete) and docs/openapi/api-contract.locked.yaml (890 lines, the human-authored locked contract). Code is in src/main/java/uk/gov/defra/trade/imports/addressbook (about 4,700 lines across 95 files): address/ (21 files, about 1,400 lines: the record, request and response, roles and role groups, the role validators, controller, service, list query), transporter/ (19 files, about 1,300 lines: the transporter record, private-or-commercial type, approval number and Northern Ireland country rules, controller, service, list query), top-level shared list and scoping classes (OrganisationScope, OrganisationScopedListQuery, ListMatchCriteria, ListPaging, SearchTerms, RequestedListFilterSupport, ExpiryIndexes, ClassLevelViolations), filter/IdentityHeaderFilter (the organisation header trust boundary), exceptions/ (the problem+json error shapes), and infrastructure (metrics/, configuration/ incl. tls/, logging/). Tests in src/test (about 9,800 lines): unit tests beside each package and 27 Testcontainers ITs in integration/. The repo keeps no rulings or decisions ledger: the only judgement-like documents are docs/review/EUDPA-58-review.md and its items JSON, a historical code review of the first build, not rulings. The source's scope is the address record: fields, types or usages (now roles), validation, organisation scoping and the API, so the extract covers address/, the shared list, paging, search and scoping classes, the identity filter, the error shapes, the expiry rules, the OpenAPI contract, the transporter record and API (the address book's other record, which the transporter-management blocked area and ruling:ian-2026-11-06 both turn on), and the tests that prove each. Left out: metrics/, configuration/ other than AddressTtlConfig, MongoConfig and OpenApiConfig, configuration/tls/, logging/, filter/HealthCheckFilter and RequestTracingFilter, application YAML beyond the TTL and environment settings, compose/, docker/, Dockerfile, pom.xml, .github/ workflows, .claude/, sonar config, and docs/review/ (2,660 lines of code-review history, no requirement or ruling).
